audit_items.proof_trace: When `total_supply == 0`, `exchange_rate()` returns exactly 1.0 (L92-95), and `int_div(collateral_amount, 1.0)` = `WAD * collateral_amount / WAD` = `collateral_amount` — strictly 1:1 with no rounding loss. There is no public donation mechanism: `deposit_underlying` is private and only called from `mint_ctokens` (which proportionally mints ctokens) and `repay_amount` (where excess goes to `cash_reserve`, neutralizing any exchange-rate effect). The first-depositor inflation attack is structurally impossible because every path that adds tokens to `underlying_balance` either mints proportional ctokens or adds equally to `cash_reserve`, keeping `cash + debt − cash_reserve` (the exchange-rate numerator) unchanged.
